title: More sequences, two temperatures
story: Sampling temperature controls how adventurous the designs are: low (0.1) stays close to what ProteinMPNN likes best, higher (0.3) gives more variety. Make 8 sequences for inputs/{{target}}.pdb at 0.1 into out_t01, then 8 at 0.3 into out_t03.

lesson.title: How many, and how varied

parts.note: Designs per structure. The default is 1.
Lower means safer, more similar designs. The ProteinMPNN authors suggest 0.1 to 0.3.
A separate folder for each setting, so runs don't overwrite each other.

lesson.why: Two runs at different temperatures give you a careful set and a varied set to compare.

hints: The environment is already active. `python /opt/ProteinMPNN/protein_mpnn_run.py --pdb_path inputs/{{target}}.pdb --out_folder out_t01 --num_seq_per_target 8 --sampling_temp 0.1`
Run it again with `--sampling_temp 0.3` and `--out_folder out_t03`.
